hint: Each manager is a whole assistant, running wherever you choose.
unsupported: This hub's version doesn't support managers yet. Update the hub and come back.
delete_builtin: The manager the hub runs itself can't be deleted
delete_default: The default manager can't be deleted. Make another one the default first
err_default: This is the default manager. Make another one the default before deleting it
err_builtin: The hub runs this manager itself. It can't be deleted or installed elsewhere
err_gone: This manager is no longer there
err_installing: It isn't installed yet. Rename it or make it the default once it is
err_forbidden: This device isn't allowed to make changes
name: Name
move_confirm: Installing elsewhere gives you a new install code. Once it's installed with that code, the manager where it ran before stops working right away.
delete_confirm: Delete “{name}”? Its token stops working right away and its connections are closed.
cancel_install_confirm: Cancel installing “{name}”? Its install code will stop working.
new_hint: You get an install code. Install it on the computer that will run it within 10 minutes.
commands_note: Run one of these on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list. The code works once.
code_note: Install the manager with this code on the computer that will run it. Once installed, it shows up in the list.
